newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB ups share price outlook.
newsitem.headline: WestLB ups share price outlook.

text.p: Westdeutsche Landesbank said on Friday it had raised its forecast for Dresdner Bank AG's share price to between 60 marks and 62 marks ($35.6 and $36.78) over the next six months from an earlier forecast of 55 marks.
Dresdner was quoted at 54.20 marks at 1055 GMT.

WestLB banking analyst Stefan Ermisch said he was underlining his buy recommendation for Dresdner after the bank on Thursday reported a stronger-than-expected gain of more than 40 percent in 1996 operating profit to more than 2.8 billion marks.

Ermisch also said WestLB had raised its share price outlook for Deutsche Bank AG on Monday to 99 marks from 90 marks after that bank announced a 37 percent jump in operating profit to 5.8 billion marks, also well above expectations.

The results indicated Deutsche and Dresdner earnings had been "extremely good" in the final quarter of 1996 and showed their strategy of expansion in international investment banking was paying off sooner than expected, Ermisch said.
Ermisch also reaffirmed his buy recommendation for Deutsche.
His predictions for Dresdner earnings per share are 2.95 marks for 1996, 3.20 marks for 1997 and 3.60 marks for 1998.
For Deutsche he sees 1996 earnings per share at 4.20 marks, rising to 4.95 marks in 1997 and 5.55 marks in 1998.
